title: Fired when Whiteman cut the band to sixteen pieces
summary: Whiteman told him he was fired as he downsized, and eight men left together.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So I remember going there one day and I went upstairs and he says, "You're fired."
Yeah, well, you know, then he says, "I'm sorry, but I'm going to have to cut the band down, the way things are going now, he says we can't keep the big band.
So I am going to cut it down to 16 pieces, so I went out in good company. Lenny and I and Joe and Eddie and let's see, there were eight of us altogether.
